notes.title: 24th update to Heraldry Studio
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35775928/3e6d7ac60d7f5571bd680a5f4ad5bebf1a70a349.jpg[/img]
In this update I implemented a feature that I wanted for a long time - outlines!
As you have noticed, Heraldry Studio is not a vector program. Everything is rasterized. Therefore getting outlines to work wasn't easy, but the result mostly looks great.
Switch outlines "ON" in the top layer, right under the shield shape selector.

Do you like the outlines? Tell us in the HS Discord: https://discord.gg/StwnxP6

notes.title: 14th update to Heraldry Studio
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35775928/f12071e06dd5e4fa1a97ddf0ea12027de0be69fd.jpg[/img]
How is everybody?
A rather technical update this time. Until now Heraldry Studio has worked single-threaded, like programs of ancient computing times. I tried to include some multi-threading for resource loading and similar things. I have to confess, computers won this time, and HS still isn't multi-threaded program. Nevertheless some speed improvements were achieved anyway - now larger resource file size will not impact speed.

Two partition styles - "Arched" and "Rayonny" - are added to the list. They were secretly in anyway and would appear in random coats of arms, so, after a vote in Discord, I added them to be picked deliberately. They might look buggy in some configurations.

Vote is on again: it's time to pick the next batch of charges to add!
